Context engineering, tool design, evals, tracing, cost. You're responsible for whether the agent works in production.Make ClickStack a great place to run AI workloads. Build the MCP servers, SDKs, and integrations that let customers' agents read telemetry, take action, and stay observable themselves.Work in the open. Collaborate with OSS contributors and customers, debug their problems alongside them, and feed what you learn back into the product.Tackle the hard parts. Comfortable in both, even if one is primary.Hands-on experience building agents: multi-step tool use, planning, memory, error recovery. title: Automation Engineer
description: About The CompanyAmazon.com LLC is a global leader in e-commerce and cloud computing, renowned for its innovative approach to customer service and operational excellence. Our culture fosters innovation, inclusivity, and a relentless pursuit of excellence, making us an employer of choice for talented professionals seeking to make a meaningful impact in a dynamic environment.About The RoleAs an Automation Engineer at Amazon, you will be instrumental in maintaining and enhancing the reliability and efficiency of our material handling and robotic systems within our fulfillment centers. Your primary focus will be on maximizing equipment uptime, troubleshooting complex control systems, and implementing improvements that drive operational performance. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including maintenance, operations, and engineering, to analyze system metrics, resolve technical issues, and support the deployment of innovative automation solutions. Your expertise in PLC programming, industrial controls, and automation technology will directly contribute to our mission of delivering customer orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work with cutting-edge automation technology in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.QualificationsTo succeed in this role, candidates should possess a minimum of a bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or a related field. Alternatively, candidates with at least 2+ years of experience in PLC programming, automation engineering, or process automation in a production or industrial environment are encouraged to apply. Essential qualifications include experience with PLCs from Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or Codesys, along with proficiency in Ladder Logic and structured programming. Candidates should also have a solid understanding of industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, and Profibus, as well as experience troubleshooting motor controls, drives, and electrical systems. Flexibility to work varied schedules, including nights, weekends, and holidays, is required. We also provide a 401(k) retirement savings plan with company matching contributions, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave to support work-life balance. Employees receive lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes to ensure safety on the job. Additional benefits include Employee Assistance Programs, mental health support, flexible spending accounts, and reimbursement for adoption and surrogacy expenses. We are committed to creating a safe, inclusive, and rewarding work environment where every employee can thrive and grow.Equal OpportunityAmazon.com LLC is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace.
